input: hi, want to start a weekly egg subscription for the family here in hsr layout. 30 eggs a week, desi / naati eggs only, real desi eggs like from the village, farm-fresh and healthy for the kids. delivery every sunday morning, budget upto ₹600 a week. can u set up the best one?

experiences.name: Hoskote Harvest Weekly Veg Basket (5 kg)
experiences.description: A 5 kg basket of seasonal vegetables picked for the week: greens, beans, tomatoes, gourds and more, depending on the harvest. Sourced from growers near Hoskote and delivered Sunday in reusable crates.

experiences.name: Kaveri Valley Naati Eggs — 30/week
experiences.description: Naati-breed hens • third-party audited free-range: daily outdoor access to pasture, no cages • audit report linked. Thirty eggs every week from a single farm near Mandya, packed in 30-egg paper trays and delivered to HSR Layout on Sunday, 7–9am.

experiences.name: Naati Nest 100% Desi Eggs — 30/week
experiences.description: 100% Desi • Farm Fresh • Natural. Thirty desi eggs every week, collected from farms around Kolar, packed in 30-egg paper trays and delivered to HSR Layout on Sunday, 7–9am. Hen breed and housing system: not specified. Third-party audit: none listed.

experiences.name: Tumakuru Ragi Flakes — 1 kg/week
experiences.description: Wholesome finger-millet flakes for a quick, kid-friendly breakfast porridge. Ragi grown in Tumakuru, flaked and packed in Bengaluru, and delivered weekly.

experiences.name: Doddaballapur Giriraja Farm Eggs — 30/week
experiences.description: Giriraja country-breed hens • third-party audited free-range: outdoor range access, barn with perches and nest boxes, no cages. Thirty eggs every week from a single farm in Doddaballapur, collected Saturday and delivered to HSR Layout on Sunday, 7–9am.

experiences.name: Ganuga Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil — 1 L/month
experiences.description: Traditional wood-pressed (ganuga) groundnut oil for everyday cooking. Pressed in Chikkaballapur and bottled in glass, with a monthly delivery.

experiences.name: Hosur Pure Country Eggs — 30/week
experiences.description: Pure Country Eggs • Farm Fresh • Rich in Nutrition. Thirty country eggs every week, sourced from farms near Hosur through aggregators, graded and packed in Electronic City and delivered to HSR Layout on Sunday, 7–9am. Housing system: not specified. Third-party audit: none listed.
